entries.title: Infinitary's window opens sooner after an update or a restart
entries.body: When Infinitary starts your first mate as it opens, after an update or a restart, its window now appears at once instead of waiting for your first mate to be ready, and your cards appear as soon as your first mate is. A message you type before then is sent once your first mate is ready.
entries.noPicture: The window looks the same as before; it only appears sooner.
